items.title: Ford Motor (F) Eyes NATO Ranger Military Sales
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) is moving to market its Ranger pickup trucks for use by NATO militaries, aiming to supply standardized light utility vehicles across member countries. Ford is seeking mainstream sales not seen by its earlier, more expensive electric vehicles.
